idea-plugin.name: RDN
idea-plugin.description:
First-class RDN (Rich Data Notation) support for all IntelliJ-based IDEs.

RDN is a strict JSON superset that adds native representations for dates, BigInts, regular expressions, binary data, Maps, Sets, tuples, durations, and special numeric values. Any valid JSON is valid RDN.

Features

  • Syntax Highlighting — full token-level coloring for all RDN constructs with customizable color schemes
  • Real-time Diagnostics — validates files as you type, catching syntax errors, unquoted keys, and invalid binary literals
  • Quick Fixes — wrap unquoted object keys in quotes (single or batch)
  • Code Completion — keywords, schema property, and 12 snippet templates for dates, collections, binary, regex, and more
  • Hover Documentation — rich popups for DateTime, TimeOnly, Duration, BigInt, binary, RegExp, and collection types with configurable format strings
  • Document Formatting — full-document formatter with Prettier integration when available
  • Sort Keys — recursively sort all object keys alphabetically (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+S)
  • Bracket Matching & Code Folding — for objects, arrays, tuples, maps, and sets
  • Auto-Indent — smart indentation on Enter inside brackets
  • Markdown Support — syntax highlighting in RDN code blocks inside Markdown files
  • Per-Project Settings — configure formatting, hover categories, format strings, and diagnostics per project

action.description: Recursively sort all object keys alphabetically and reformat the document
